Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-03, batch 95 (Centersquare): operator market page confirmed name, utility power, and raised floor sqft, capacity_note applied, a single uncorroborated geocode lead recorded in the reading only, research_status upgraded from exhausted to complete, no address applied.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility is attributed in the registry to Centersquare. This session found that centersquaredc.com, the legacy domain matching this registry entire Centersquare operator bucket naming, now issues a live redirect to www.csquare.com, the operator current domain, confirmed directly this session. Csquare own site states it owns and operates data centers built over decades by developing, acquiring, integrating, and operating advanced data centers, without giving a specific founding or rebrand date on the pages fetched this session. Csquare own site, fetched this session, lists corporate headquarters at 3100 Olympus Blvd, Suite 510, Coppell, TX 75019, and states a current portfolio of 80 total data centers, about 3.5 million square feet, more than 500 MW of power capacity, and more than 36,000 cross connects, across 15 North American markets plus London. On at least two Csquare pages fetched this session, a customer facing portal link pointed to evoquedcs.my.site.com, suggesting some relationship to Evoque Data Center Solutions, though this session found no page stating the exact nature of that relationship, such as whether Centersquare or Csquare is a direct rebrand of Evoque or a separate successor. Separately, this registry also carries an unrelated Cyxtera operator bucket, not part of this batch, already documented by an earlier pass in this registry as tracing to the same May 2017 CenturyLink data center divestiture discussed in this session own Lumen Technologies research, and as acquired by Cologix in 2023 per Cologix own site. This session found no evidence connecting that Cyxtera and Cologix history to the Centersquare, Csquare, or Evoque names researched for this batch, so the two threads are treated as distinct and unconfirmed to be related. This registry also carries a separate Csquare operator bucket, not part of this batch, whose name is now confirmed by the redirect evidence above to very likely be the same current brand as the Centersquare bucket this batch covers, though this session did not merge or rename either bucket, flagging this as an open duplicate operator naming question for a future dedicated pass rather than resolving it unilaterally. The operator own current market page for Atlanta, fetched this session, describes this facility as Lithia Springs ATL1 and states 81.5 MW of combined utility power and 102,421 square feet of raised floor, with no street address published on that page. A single reverse geocode attempt this session for this row coordinates returned 375 Riverside Pkwy, Lithia Springs, GA at 0.9 confidence and 0.098 distance, before the reverse geocoding service returned to a throttled state on the very next attempt tried in this batch. Consistent with this session standard this batch of treating a single geocode without independent corroboration as a lead rather than a confirmed fact, that address is recorded here as a lead only and is not applied to the address field.
